movement.say: p i i equals 1 minus omega i, the share of the day spent at home
p i j equals omega i times A j e to the minus beta T i j, divided by the sum over k not equal to i of A k e to the minus beta T i k
N tilde j, the people present in place j, equals the sum over k of p k j times N k

ngm.say: M equals kappa times D N times P times W times P transpose
W is the diagonal matrix of V j over N tilde j squared
kappa equals a squared b c nu over mu v times nu plus mu v times gamma plus mu h

r0.say: R naught squared equals the largest eigenvalue of S

r0.tex: S = \kappa\,D_N^{1/2} P W P^{\top} D_N^{1/2} = \kappa\sum_j w_j\,q_j q_j^{\top}
r0.say: S equals kappa D N to the one half P W P transpose D N to the one half, equal to kappa times the sum over j of w j q j q j transpose

sandwich.say: the smallest local exposure number is at most R naught squared, which is at most the largest local exposure number
R i equals kappa times the sum over j of p i j m j
R naught squared is at least kappa times total mosquitoes over total people

shares.say: s j equals kappa w j times q j dot v squared, over R naught squared; the shares add up to one
the derivative of R naught squared with respect to u j equals minus kappa w j times q j dot v squared

program.say: minimize the sum of c j u j

program.tex: \text{subject to}\quad r^2 I - S(u) \succeq 0,\quad 0 \le u_j \le \bar u_j
program.say: subject to r squared I minus S of u positive semidefinite, and u j between 0 and u bar j

certificate.say: kappa times the sum over j of p i j m j times 1 minus u j is at most r squared for every i
implies R naught of u is at most r

barrier.say: phi t of u equals t c transpose u minus log det of r squared I minus S of u
minus the sum of log u j minus the sum of log of u bar j minus u j

dual.tex: g(Z) = \sum_j \bar u_j \min\{0,\ c_j - \kappa w_j\, q_j^{\top} Z q_j\}
dual.say: g of Z equals the sum over j of u bar j times the minimum of 0 and c j minus kappa w j q j transpose Z q j
minus the trace of Z times r squared I minus S of 0, which is at most the least cost

inversion.say: the largest error in z hat is at most the largest error in the rates divided by the smallest value of 2 p i i minus 1

cusum.say: S t equals the maximum of 0 and S t minus 1 plus x t minus k t
k t equals theta minus 1 times mu t over the natural log of theta
alarm when S t reaches h

arl.say: alarm by week tau plus the ceiling of h over delta minus 1
average run length equals the first entry of I minus Q inverse times the vector of ones

season.say: R naught squared in season sigma equals sigma times R naught squared in the reference season

threshold.say: R naught equals 1 at m equal to 1 over kappa, about 1.71 mosquitoes per person
